quest.title: Who Is Mondstadt's Strongest Fighter?
quest.description: Customers at the Angel's Share have started debating the hottest topic on Mondstadt's streets: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?"
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Mora x18000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: We must investigate further to find out why the Abyss Order has been so active lately.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, please be on your guard.

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: *sigh* Shame I only get to listen in from the other side of the window and don't get to join in the debate. I'd love to give my two cents...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Say what? What's up, what's up? Paimon wants in!

dialogues.speaker: Patton
dialogues.text: Recently, all the customers at the tavern have been debating the exact same topic: "Who is the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The strongest fighter?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Must be someone who can floor a whole gang of hilichurls with just one punch!

choices.text: There must be far more to it than that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow... then it really must be tough to become the strongest of all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But anyway... Is there, like, a general agreement in the city on who it is, or...?

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: Hah. Expecting people to come to a swift and straightforward consensus in the City of Freedom is like expecting Fisherman's Toast to drop out of the sky.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: Everyone's got their own opinion, backed up by a unique set of cherry-picked information... But let's be honest, that's what makes the discussion so impassioned and entertaining.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: Mainstream opinion is polarized, with most people supporting one of two candidates.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: One is the Dandelion Knight, the other is the Darknight Hero.

choices.text: Paimon, who are you voting for?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon votes for you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But let's go into the <color=#00E1FFFF>tavern</color> and talk to the patrons. Maybe we'll pick up some juicy gossip.

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: Oh, I do envy your life of leisure...

response.speaker: Patton
response.text: But don't mind me, of course. *sigh* I guess I'll just... get back to work.

choices.text: Anyone vote for me?
Pff! I do that for fun.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then Paimon nominates you!

talks.objective: Talk to Patton about recent conversation topics

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Patton was right about one thing.

choices.text: Everyone has an opinion.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If everyone's got their own opinion and can't be persuaded...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...How are we ever gonna find out who Mondstadt's strongest fighter is?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Eureka! Paimon's got it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go see what <color=#00E1FFFF>Jean</color> says.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bet the Knights have got an official ranking table for this kind of thing!

choices.text: What makes you so sure?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, let's just go and ask already. We'll never find out if we don't!

choices.text: Ooh! Do you think I'll be on there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Guess it depends if they counted all your shenanigans or not.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry though, Paimon has full confidence in your abilities!

choices.text: Not just that, but some people's choice of candidate was just plain weird.

talks.objective: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You want to know who I think the toughest fighter is?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: In my opinion, that would be the finest adventurer of them all — Stanley.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Guild Master Cyrus is up there with the toughest, too, but only Stanley can take on the bloodthirsty beasts of the Mare Jivari!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Bloodthirsty beasts of the Mare Jivari? Sounds terrifying!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: D'you reckon you'd be scared if you were faced with one of those?

choices.text: I'd beat it to a pulp.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Bam, wham, pow!

choices.text: I'd run for my life.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sensible choice. Safety first and all that.

talks.objective: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: Er... *hic* The strongest fighter of them all?

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: That would be Jean, obviously! *hic*

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: Why? Grand Master Jean is so strong... she can take out a Ruin Guard with just a few slashes of her sword. *hic*

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: And she could wipe out the three hilichurl tribes at Dadaupa Gorge all by her... *hic* self.

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: Otherwise, we wouldn't have such a carefree existence... with nothing to do...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's true that Jean makes people feel they're in safe hands.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Meanwhile, this guy is drunk as a skunk!

talks.objective: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: The strongest fighter? I don't pay much attention to that sort of thing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Paimon thought bartenders had some kind of special information sources.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just like they have an exclusive supplier of wine?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly! That's what Paimon was getting at.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I have no involvement in any intelligence-gathering operation.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: But if you made me pick someone, it would be the Darknight Hero.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I've heard some stories about him. Apparently, he once rescued a city dweller from the Abyss Order.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There it is — the barman's top-secret intelligence!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of the Abyss Order, their minions are really stirring up trouble all over the place, aren't they?

talks.objective: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Who's the strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Eh? The most macho in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: ...She's a little girlie who wears red.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A girl dressed in red?

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: That's right! I found this out one day about half a month ago, when I went to the Stormbearer Mountains looking for inspiration for my new song.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Guess what happened?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What happened?

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: I witnessed the most powerful destructive force I have ever seen in my life!

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: I'm telling you, it completely changed the whole landscape in that part of the mountains!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Holy moly!

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: I was hiding behind a bush and I saw this little girlie in red clothing running into the distance, leaving a trail of destruction in her wake.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: *sigh* But I don't know if anyone will believe me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Now that you mention it, the idea of a tiny little girl wielding that much destructive power is a little far-fetched...

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: You want to know what I think? I think she has a treasure nobody else knows about.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Maybe even the most powerful treasure in all of Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you say treasure!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, did Paimon imagine that or did you hear it too?

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: It's... just a guess. I mean... No, it's a bard's razor-sharp intuition!

choices.text: I don't buy it.

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: How can you say such a thing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, this girl. What's her name?

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: Ah... I do not know her name. I do not see her often in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: Hey, I am telling the truth! You gotta believe me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmmm... Doesn't sound like much to go on...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But thanks for your intel!

choices.text: I'll take you at your word, for now.

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: #Thank you, amig{M#o}{F#a}! Ah, I am so happy to meet a true amig{M#o}{F#a}. Who would have thought—

talks.objective: Ask tavern patrons about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Laters! Happy adventuring!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Um, who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: You can call me Six-Fingered José, it's okay.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: I am a beloved bard of Mondstadt... Or I should say, I used to be beloved.

choices.text: Sing for me, José, por favor!

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: Oh? You want to hear my latest song? I call it Ode to a Morning Breeze.

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: ...I just need to tune my instrument.

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: Uh-oh...

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: I am so sorry. I have had no audience to play for for so long that now my strings are a little... I'll sing for you next time.

choices.text: Are there many other bards in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: #Are you kidding me, amig{M#o}{F#a}? Mondstadt is known all over for its songs from the pastures!

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: But lately a mysterious bard appeared in this place. I checked all over, but I can't find out anything about him.

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: Since he came here, my audience has slowly disappeared.

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: I did consider a battle of the bards...

response.speaker: Six-Fingered José
response.text: But I think even I would be seduced by his beautiful voice...

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

dialogues.text: I—I'm fine! I'm not hurt! Sorry for bumping into you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You dropped something.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look, there's some writing on here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Explosion inside city wall, grounded be thy woe," "Explosions can hurt people, Jean can be dreadful," "Mondstadt be bombed, Klee be doomed..."
Yikes...
Mr. Kaeya wrote these down for me, um... they're, um... survival rules.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Survival rules?
Y—Yeah... Rules that I must absolutely never break under any circumstances.
Otherwise, something terrible would happen.

choices.text: Kaeya writes like this?

response.text: Yep!
Ah, I forgot to introduce myself!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: My name is Klee.

choices.text: Hello, Klee.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I've heard all about you guys! You're the Honorary Knight who helps Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: More recognition, yay! Paimon is so happy right now.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I heard it from Amber... But wait, no— there's no time for this right now.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I'm dealing with a big emergency. I grabbed my map and ran as fast as I could all the way here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's wrong?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Th—The treasure I buried in the <color=#00E1FFFF>Whispering Woods</color>, it's... gone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you say... buried treasure!?

choices.text: I think she needs our help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly what Paimon was thinking!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Lost treasure is a big deal. Let us help you find it!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yay! Thanks, you guys!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Here! Here's where the map says the treasure should be. I put a circle round it.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I also put a wooden sign in the ground at the place where I buried it. To make it easier to find!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (...Paimon is starting to understand how this treasure went missing so easily.)

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Come on {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, let's go!

choices.text: A girl dressed in red, hmm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And she has treasure!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: (Seriously? Klee gets Six-Fingered José's vote for strongest fighter in Mondstadt? What is wrong with people...)

choices.text: #My name is {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And Paimon's name is... well, Paimon.

choices.text: Something terrible?

talks.objective: Ask Jean about the strongest fighter in Mondstadt

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Master Jean! Sorry to bother you, we're collecting intel on the strongest fighter in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you have... uh, one of those... official Knights of Favonius—verified ranking table... thingies?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Strongest fighter in Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I am sorry, but I cannot help. I do not have any relevant documentation on that topic...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh... Well, that sucks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon was hoping {NICKNAME} would at least make the top five.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Hehe. Well, although I do not have the data to make such an assessment, I will say that my faith in our Honorary Knight's abilities has never wavered.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Which reminds me...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Recently, one of the Abyss Order's Mages has been active near the city, although he is keeping a low profile.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: If you are staying around Mondstadt, please be on the lookout for danger.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Given your... well, high-ranking fighting strength, I trust you will be able to help keep the area safe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Awesome! After {NICKNAME} defeats the Abyss Order, {F#she'll}{M#he'll} climb up that ranking table faster than {F#she}{M#he} climbs up all those cliffs!

choices.text: Paimon. There is no ranking table.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, either way, smashing the Abyss Order to bits is the right thing to do.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Hehe. I like your enthusiasm. It is infectious.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: But be careful out there.

choices.text: D'you think I'll get to first place?

talks.objective: Leave the Knights of Favonius office

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: What'll it be today?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hey, I'm doing some adventurer's training... alcohol tolerance training, to be precise... Wanna join me?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You seem to have had one too many.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Really? Let me see... eight beers, five wines, seven ciders... Not so much!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I'm no match for those legendary Mondstadt adventurers who can drink half of Cider Lake's worth of wine...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: ...Only a figure of speech? Really? No wonder... I could never figure out how they could afford so much wine on an adventurer's income...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: What kind of liquor do you prefer?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Me...? Beer. I don't like it that much though...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: It's just that... beggars can't be choosers...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: As long as it gets me drunk, it's all good... Don't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: #Hey, amig{M#o}{F#a}!

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: #Do you want to hear my latest composition? I put my whole heart into it, and also my soul. How about it, amig{M#o}{F#a}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: Leaving so soon? You are a busy bee.

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: If you ever have time to spare, I won't complain if you come here and show me some appreciation.

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: Hi! Are you here to try Mondstadt's famous wine too?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: What do you mean? I'm off work...

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: I sleep better when I've had a little tipple after work to take the edge off.

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: ...Huh? What difference does it make when I slack off all day anyway, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: Well there's nothing to do because... because Mondstadt is just so peaceful, that's why.

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: I'm sure my life would have been more interesting if I'd gone with the Adventurers' Guild instead...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...What makes you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: Just think. As an adventurer, you'd get to go explore wherever you wanted, literally anywhere in the seven nations of Teyvat...

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: And best of all, you can make a living from it! What could be more fun than that?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hey, I'm doing some adventurer's training... alcohol tolerance training, to be precise... Wanna join me?

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: #Hey, amig{M#o}{F#a}!

dialogues.speaker: Six-Fingered José
dialogues.text: #Do you want to hear my latest composition? I put my whole heart into it, and also my soul. How about it, amig{M#o}{F#a}?

dialogues.speaker: Bruce
dialogues.text: Hi! Are you here to try Mondstadt's famous wine too?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Any recommendations?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: The apple cider from the Dawn Winery is a special at Angel's Share.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: You can try my special cocktail if you want. The cocktail is on the house if it's your first time here.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: You want to know about me?

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I've been working as a bartender here for more than a decade. I'm employed by the Dawn Winery, like everyone else.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I'm not that interested in alcohol, but it's my job so...

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: I mean, I'm not like Diona at Cat's Tail. I heard she hates alcohol.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Occasionally, Master Diluc, the owner of the winery, will cover my shift.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Days off are precious after all, so I'm very thankful to him for that.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Not right now, thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Charles
dialogues.text: Really? Shouldn't drink too much anyway, I guess.
